description: Tree up to 30 m high, often with buttresses; bark grayish; young shoots appressed yellowish tomentose. Leaves unpaired bipinnate. Petiole 5–20 cm; main rachis 10–60 cm long, pubescent when young later sub-glabrous. Pinnae 3–5 pairs. Leaflets 4–9 pairs, ovate to ovate-oblong, acuminate, slightly oblique, subsessile, when young pubescent beneath later glabrous, 2–15 by 2–7 cm. Racemes 1–3 together, dense, 20–25 cm. Pedicel 6–8 mm. Flowers reflxed after anthesis. Receptacle pubescent, 6–8 mm long. Sepals pubescent, 3–4 mm long with rounded apex. Petals red, linear-cuneate, 6–10 mm long. Filaments yellowish-orange with green base, glabrous, thick, twice the length of the petals. Ovary with 15–20 ovules. Pods long-stalked, 8–15 by 1–2 cm, flat, slightly torulose, with a 3–5 mm broad wing along the upper suture. Seeds pale brown, compressed.
contributor: K. Larsen, S.S. Larsen, J.E. Vidal
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree up to 30 m high, with a broad crown; bark smooth, grey; young shoots ± puberulous later glabrous. Leaves glabrous. Petioles ca 2 cm; rhachis 15–20 cm. Stipules minute, caduceus. Leaflets 3–5 pairs, oblong-ovoid, with ± rounded, slightly emargiuate apex; base truncate, 5–9 by 4–5 cm; petiolules 3–5 mm. Panicles 5–15 cm, grayish pubescent. Pedicels 7–10 mm. Bracts ovate-oblong, greyish pubescent, 6–9 mm; bracteoles similar, persistent. Receptacle 8–10 mm, greyish pubescent as the sepals. Sepals oblong, 10–12 mm. Petal pink, with a 5–12 mm long claw; lamina oblong, emarginate, 7–9 mm long. Stamens 7, filaments 30 mm, pubescent at base; anthers 3–4 mm long, opening by a slit; staminodes 3, short, filiform. Ovary hairy ca 7 mm, with a 7 mm long stipe; style glabrous, 20–25 mm long, slightly enlarged towards the stigma. Pods brown, woody-valved; valves 5–7 mm thick, 15–20 by 7–9 cm. Seeds (excluded aril) 2.5–3 cm long, 2–2.5 cm broad, 0.8–1.2 cm thick; aril orange, cup-shaped, ca 1.5 cm long.
contributor: K. Larsen, S.S. Larsen, J.E. Vidal

description: Evergreen tree up to 15 m high; young shoots pendulous, finely puberulous. Leaves paripinnate; rachis 20–40 cm long including short, stout petiole. Stipules foliaceous, narrow lanceolate, caduceus, 2–3 cm long. Leaflets 6–8 pairs; petiolules thick, 4–7 mm; lamina oblong to ovate-oblong, with rounded base and long acuminate apex, glabrous, 5–15 by 3–4.5 cm, increasing in size upwards. Racemes red, terminal, lax, pendulous, 50–80 cm. Bracts early caduceus; bracteoles red, persistent, broadly lanceolate, acuminate, 4–9 by 2–3 cm. Pedicels red, finely pubescent, up to 6 cm. Receptacle red, as long as sepals. Sepals 4, petaloid, subequal, linear oblong, blunt, 3–5 by 0.5–2 cm. Petals 5, unequal; the lower 2 minute, setaceous, 2 mm long; lateral ones spathulate, red with rounded yellow apex; upper one fan shaped with wavy upper margin, red–spotted with a red V surrounded by a yellow, quadrangular patch near apex, 4.5 cm broad at apex; Stamens 10; 9 connate into a 3 cm long, pink sheet; 5 of these with up to 4cm of free filament, anthers 8 mm long; 4 alternate stamens with 0.2–0.3 cm of free filament and small anthers; upper stamen free, 2.5 cm long with small anther; anthers opening by a slit. Ovary with a stipe 0.7 cm long, adnate to the receptacle; style red, filiform, 4 cm long; stigma terminal, capitellate; ovules 3–6. Pods long-stalked, dehiscent, oblong, falcate, flat, glabrous, thickened towards the upper suture, 15–20 by 3–4 cm. Seeds 4–6, transversely ovate, orbicular, compressed.
contributor: K. Larsen, S.S. Larsen, J.E. Vidal

description: Erect shrub up to 3 m high; young branches greyish pubescent, later glabrous. Leaves ovate to rotundate, up to 14 by 13 cm, 9–11-nerved; bifid to ⅓(–½) with broad sinus, tip of lobes triangular acute; base cordate to subtruncate; upper surface glabrous, lower greyish-brown pubescent particularly on the nerves. Stipules linear, ca 1 cm long, caduceus. Petioles pubescent, 3–4 cm. Racemes branched, lateral and terminal, short, 3–10-flowered. Pedicels 5–15(–20) mm. Bracts linear-acuminate; bracteoles similar, inserted below the middle of the pedicel. Buds (including receptacle) up to 4 cm long, fusiform, thinly hairy to glabrous, apex with 5 free calyx-teeth, 3 mm long. Receptacle turbinate, ± striate, ca 5 mm long. Calyx spathaceous. Petals white, oblong, blunt, 4–6 by 2 cm, shortly clawed. Stamens 10 fertile, subequal; filaments 15–25 mm long, hairy at base; anthers 3–5 mm long. Ovary stipitate, subglabrous: style-subglabrous, up to 15 mm; stigma small, peltate. Pods dehiscent, up to 11 by 1.5 cm with sharp-edged, raised sutures. Seeds 5–11, flattened, up to 1 cm diam.
contributor: K. Larsen, S.S. Larsen, J.E. Vidal

description: Large tendrilled climber; young branches rusty tomentose, later glabrescent to glabrous. Leaves ovate, up to 19 by 13 cm, 9–13-nerved; bifid to ½–⅔ with narrow sinus, tip of lobes triangular, obtuse to acuminate; base cordate to truncate; upper surface glabrous, lower brownish tomentose to glabrescent. Stipules ear-shaped, up to 6 mm long, caducous. Petioles glabrescent, 2–7 cm. Inflorescences lateral or terminal broad racemes or panicles, many-flowered; axis rusty tomentose to glabrescent. Pedicels up to 7 cm. Bracts linear-lanceolate up to 8 mm, bracteoles smaller, inserted near the middle of the pedicel. Buds oblong, brownish tomentose, ovoid fusiform. Receptacle short ca 1 mm. Calyx splitting in 2 during anthesis, forming right angles with the pedicel, 5–8 mm long. Petals pubescent, yellowish-green, subequal, blade deltoid with crenulate margin, 10 by 7–8 mm, sometimes purple blotched; claw 10–2.5 mm long. Stamens 2 fertile, filaments ca 2 cm long, pubescent; anthers 1–2.5 mm long; reduced stamens 7, 3–9 mm long; staminode 1, short, filiform, between the fertile stamens. Ovary stipitate, brownish pilose; style 7–10 mm, glabrous towards the small stigma. Pods glabrescent, smooth, 9 by 3 cm. Seeds 3–5, flattened, orbicular ca 1 cm diam.
contributor: K. Larsen, S.S. Larsen, J.E. Vidal

description: Tendrilled, erect and straggling shrub, up to 5 m high; branches greyish. Leaves consisting of 2 free, obliquely ovate leaflets with broadly rounded ends, ca 3 by 2 cm, 4–5-nerved; glabrous on both sides. Stipules minute. Petioles slender, 15–25 mm. Inflorescence: lateral or terminal, short racemes, ca 6 cm long. Pedicels 1 cm. Bracts scaly; bracteoles. subulate, minute, inserted below the middle of the pedicel. Buds ovoid, pointed, finely pubescent. Receptacle 5–8 mm long, striatc. Sepals 5, lanceolate, acute, 5–6 mm long. Petals white to purplish with darker veins, short clawed, 1–2 cm long, woolly pubescent outside, less hairy inside. Stamens 10 fertile, red, subequal, up to 2cm long; anthers 3 mm long. Ovary stipitate, glabrous, 8–10 mm, stipe 2–3 mm; style red, 5 mm; stigma peltate. Pods indehiscent, ± curved, ca 20 by 3 cm with rounded ends. Seeds 6–13, flat, shining, brown, trapezoid, 10 by 7 mm.

description: Shrub or small tree up to 6 m high; young branches reddish pubescent, later glabrous. Leaves broadly ovate; 4–8 by 5–10 cm, 9–11-nerved; bifid to ⅓ with broad sinus, tip of lobes rounded-acute; base slightly cordate; upper surface glabrous, lower with scattered brownish glands and ± densely hairy. Stipules falcate, ca 2 mm long. Petioles pubescent, 1–2 cm. Racemes short, dense, leaf-opposed, 2–5 cm long. Pedicels slender, 7–8 mm. Bracts linear, 2–3 mm, bracteoles smaller, inserted at base of the pedicel. Buds ovoid, acute, brownish pubescent, ca 5 mm long. Receptacle turbinate, very short. Calyx splitting into two segments, 3 mm long. Petals white, grabrous, narrowly ovate, tapering towards the short claw, 5–7 mm long. Stamens 10 fertile, outer whorl as long as petals, inner whorl shorter; anthers tiny. Ovary 2–3 mm long, densely hairy; style short; stigma indistinct. Pods dehiscent, 3–5 by 1 cm. Seeds 2–4.

description: Large, tendrilled climber; young branches greyish pubescent, later glabrous. Leaves ovate to rotundate, 3–15 by 5–14 cm, 9–11-nerved, bifid to ⅓ tip. of lobes deltoid-obtuse; base cordate; upper surface glabrous, lower pubescent on the nerves. Stipules falcate-auriculate, up to 10 mm on sterile shoots, smaller on flowering shoots, caducous. Petioles sparsely pubescent, 1–7 cm. Inflorescences lateral or terminal broad racemes or panicles, many-flowered, with greyish pubescent axis. Pedicels 4–7 cm. Bracts lanceolate to broadly ovate, varying in size; bracteoles narrower, inserted at about the middle of the pedicel. Buds greyish-brown pubescent, oblong with pointed apex, zygomorphic. Receptacle 3–4 mm long. Calyx during anthesis splitting into 5 reflexed segments, 8–9 mm long. Petals yellowish-green, subequal, blade spathulate with crenulate margin, 5–13 mm long, claw ca 15 mm long. Stamens 2–3 fertile; filaments up to 35 mm long; anthers ca 3 mm long; reduced stamens 8–7: 5–6, subequal, up to 10 mm long, 1 longer placed between the 2 fertiles. Disc produced into a 2–4 mm persistent, tubular outgrowth. Ovary brownish velvety pubescent; on a 5–7 mm velvety stipe, tapering towards the velvety style; stigma capitate. Pods dehisccnt, flat, woody-valved, glabrous, dark brown, ca 17 by 5 cm, narrowed towards the base. Seeds 2–8, flattened, orbioular, ca 15 mm diam.

description: Tendrilled climber or shrub; young branches densely greyish pubescent, later glabrous. Leaves entire, ovate, 3.5–9 by 1–5 cm, 5–7-nerved; apex obtuse to acuminate, base cordate; upper surface glabrous, lower ferrugincous pubescent. Stipules caducous (not seen). Petioles 1–3 cm. Racemes greyish pubescent, lateral or terminal, unbranched or branched up to 20 cm long. Pedicels ca 1 cm. Bracts subulate, 2 mm long; bracteoles minute, inserted below the middle of the pedicel. Buds globose, 2–3 mm diam. including the very short receptacle. Calyx splitting into ± free, oblanceolate, cucullate, obtuse, 3 mm long segments, later reflexed. Petals greenish, obovate with emarginate apex, ca 5 mm long including the short claw. Stamens 3 fertile; filaments 4–5 mm long; anthers ca 1 mm long; staminodes 2, minute; disc glabrous. Ovary glabrous, ca 2.5 mm long on a short stipe; style glabrous; ovules few. Pods strap-shaped, thin-valved, 4–5 by 1–1.3 cm diam.

description: Tendrilled shrub to large climber; young branches greyish puberulous. Leaves broadly ovate to ovate-oblong, 5–7 by 2.5–6 cm, 5–7-nerved; entire to emarginate or bifid ⅕ with broad sinus, tip of lobes acute to subacute; base rounded to slightly cordate; upper surface glossy, subglabrous, lower pubescent to subglabrous. Stipules minute, acute. Petioles ± pubescent, 1–3.5 cm. Racemes lateral and terminal, lax- flowered, mainly unbranehed, 10-20 cm long; main axis greyish-pubescent. Pedicels capillary, up to 2 cm long. Bracts 1–2 mm long; bracteoles minute, inserted at about the middle of the pedicel. Buds ovoid-acute, pubescent, 2–3 mm long. Receptacle short. Calyx splitting into 2–3 segments. Petals greenish, 5–7 mm, unequal, two lower spathulate, 3 upper very narrow, claw 2–3 mm. Stamens 3 fertile; filaments 4–5 mm; anthers oblong, caduceus; staminodes 2, minute. Ovary glabrous, shortly stipitate, emerging laterally from the yellow, glabrous disc; style short; stigma inconspicuous. Pods dehiscent, strap-shaped, 5–6 by 1.5 cm, glossy, smooth, thin-valved, with a short curved beak. Seeds 2–6, flat, ca 1 cm diam.

description: Deviates from var. sericea by having smaller buds and all floral parts. Inflorescence narrower but with larger, ± persistant bracts and bracteoles. Petals outside hairy at base and on the central part of the blade, glabrous towards apex. Staminodes absent. Sutures of ovary and stipe densely hairy. Pods dehiscent, flat, glabrous, 10–11 by 4 cm. Seeds 3–4, suborbicu1ar, ca 2 cm diam.

description: Tendrilled climber; young branches sericeous later glabous. Leaves broadly or narrowly ovate, up to 15 by 9 cm, 7–9-nerved; apex shallowly bifid with narrow sinus; tip of lobes acute to acuminate; base truncate to rounded; both surfaces glabrous, glossy; leaves on adventitious shoots larger and split into two free leaflets. Stipules ovate-falcate, ca 5 mm. Petioles glabrescent, up to 7 cm. Flowers in crowded; simple or compound, sericeous corymbs with short axis. Pedicels ca 2.5 cm. Bracts oblong, acute, ca 5 mm; bracteoles minute inserted above the middle of the pedicel. Buds globose, sericeous, with pointed apex, 4 mm diam. Receptacle tubular, striate, 2–3 mm. Calyx splitting into (2–)3(–4) reflexed segments. Petals white, sericeous outside, obovate, 8–10 mm long, tapering towards the short claw. Stamens 3 fertile; filaments filiform, slightly longer than the petals; anthers oblong, 2.5 mm; staminodes 4, joined at base plus 1 separate, minute. Ovary brownish hairy along sutures, 5 mm shortly stipitate; style glabrous 5 mm; stigma inconspicuous. Mature pods not known.

description: Deviates from subsp. glauca in the following characters: Leaves larger and only 1; bifid, 9–11-nerved, 7–9 cm long. Petiole shorter, 1–2(–3) cm. Inflorescence larger. Buds hairy as well as the 2.5–3 cm long receptacle (longer than the pedicel). Flowers slightly larger.

description: Large, tendrilled climber; young branches rusty hairy, later glabrous. Leaves ovate-suborbicular, 5–8 by 6–9 cm, (7–)9-nerved; (emarginate to) bifid to ⅕ with broad Sinus, tip of lobes rounded, base cordate; upper surface glabrous, lower glabrous to sparsely hairy particularly on the nerves. Stipules early caduobus (not seen). Petioles glabrous, 1.5–4 cm. Inflorescences large, composed of simple, elongated racemes with numerous small flowers; main axis rusty tomentose. Pedicels 2–3 mm. Bracts setaceous, 2 min long, bracteoles minute. Buds fusiform with acute tip, 2–3 mm long (including receptacle), greyish tomentose. Receptacle very short. Calyx splitting into 2–3 reflexed segments. Petals yellowish -green, spathulate, 2–3 mm long, with crenulate margins, claw short. Stamens 3 fertile, filaments twice the length of the petals; anthers narrow, 1 mm; staminodes 7, minute, sub-equal. Ovary shortly stipitate; stipe, base of ovary and sutures pilose; style glabrous, short; stigma inconspicuous; disc hairy. Pods (not mature) 11 by 2.5 cm , broadest towards the rounded, mucronate apex. Seeds 6–7 (mature seeds not seen).

description: Leaves subrottindate, often broader than long, 9–16 cm diam, 7–9-nerved; bifid to ¼–⅓ with broad sinus, tip of lobes triangular with blunt apex; base slightly cordate; upper surface glabrous, lower brownish pubescent particularly on the nerves. Stipules linear-subulate, ca 1 cm long, caducous. Petioles pubescent, 2–5 cm. Racemes lateral, short, few-flowered. Pedicels 5–15 mm. Bracts subulate, 3–6 mm; bracteoles similar, inserted below the middle of the pedicel. Buds fusiform, hirsute, up to 4 cm long, apex with 5 free calyx-teeth, 2–3 mm long. Receptacle turbinate, ca 5 mm long. Calyx spathaceous. Petals white, oblong, blunt, 3–4 by 1.5 cm, short-clawed. Stamens 10 fertile, subequal; flaments 7–20 mm long, hairy at base; anthers 2.5 mm long. Ovary stiptate, subglabrous; style glabrous 10 mm; stigma small, peltate. Pods dehiscent, up to 6–9 by 1.5.cm with curved tip. Seeds 5–10, flattened, oblong, ca 8 mm.

description: Large, tendrilled climber; young branches rusty pubescent, later glabrous. Leaves broadly ovate to rotundate, up to 12 by 15 cm. 9–11-nerved; apex entire to emarginate or shallowly bifid with a wide deltoid sinus, tip of lobes acute to rounded; base deeply cordate; upper surface glabrous, glossy, lower glabrous when fully grown. Stipules minute, rounded, early caducous. Petioles 1–5 cm. Flowers in rusty pubescent panicles composed of corymbose racemes. Pedicels slender; up to 3 cm. Bract narrowly lanceolate, up to 3 mm; bracteoles minute, inserted at about the middle of the pedicel. Buds globose with acute apex, 3–4 mm diam. Receptacle tubular, striate, 2–4 mm. Calyx splitting into 2–3 reflexed segments. Petals 8–15 mm long, orange turning red, hirsute outside, obovate, tapering towards the short claw. Stamens 3 fertile. Filaments filiform, slightly longer than the petals; anthers ellipsoid ca 1 mm; staminodes 2, minute. Ovary subsessile, ca 4 mm, rusty hirsute; style 5 mm, glabrous towards the capitate stigma. Pods dehiscent, oblong, glabrous when ripe, 15–20 by 2–5 cm. Seeds 5–8, flat, ovate-orbicular, ca 2 cm diam.

description: Large, tendrilled climber; young branches puberulous, later glabrous. Leaves ovate, 6–15 by 5–12 cm, 9–11-nerved; bird to ½ with rather narrow sinus; tip of lobes deltoid, obtuse; base cordate-truncate; both surfaces glabrous. Stipules minute, early, caduceus. Petioles glabrous, 3–7 cm. Inflorescences lateral or terminal panicles, many-flowered, with greyish pubescent axis. Pedicels 6–10 cm. Bracts lanceolate, 10 by 5 mm; bracteoles elliptic-1anceolate, 15–20 by 7–10 mm, inserted near base of receptacle. Buds greyish pubescent, oblong with pointed apex. Receptacle tubular, 7–10 mm long. Calyx splitting into 4–5 eventually reflexed segments, 10–15 mm long. Petals yellowish-green, subequal, blade rhomboidal with crenulate margins; ca 2 cm long, claw reddish, slightly longer. Stamens 3 fertile; flaments first green later red, 30 mm long, subglabrous; anthers 4–5 mm long; reduced stamens 7, red, subequal, 7–15 mm long, with small, cordate anthers. Ovary glabrous, on a 7–10 mm long stipe; style 5 mm long; stigma small, capitate. Pods dehiscent, flat, woody-valved, dark brown, 12 by 3 cm, narrow towards base. Seeds ca 5, flattened, orbicular, ca 15–25 mm diam.

description: Tendrilled climber or shrub; young branches (and all young parts) rusty pubescent, later glabrous. Leaves rotundate to reniform, 4–5 by 5–6 cm, 9-nerved; bifid to ½ with narrow sinus, tip 9 lobes rounded; base deeply cordate; upper surface subglabrous, lower appressed reddish hirsute particularly on the nerves. Stipules falcate, acute. Petioles slender, hirsute, 1.5–2 cm. Flowers in ca 5 cm long corymbs. Padicels slender, 1–1.5 cm. Bracts ca 6 mm long, subulate, hirsute; bracteoles similar, inserted near the middle of the pedicel. Buds ovoid, ca 4 mm long, reddish hirsute. Receptacle striate, reddish hirsute, 2–2.5 cm long. Calyx splitting into 5 reflexed sepals. Petals white, ovate-oblong, ca 1 cm long, shortly clawed. Stamens 3 fertile, reddish; filaments 1 cm long; anthers ellipsoid, 1–2 mm long; staminodes 7, 2 minute between the stamens, 5 small, unequal, joined at base. Ovary glabrous, very shortly stipitate; style very short; stigma obliquely peltate. Pods dehiscent, thin-valved, strap-shaped, 10–12 by 1.5–2 cm. Seeds 8–10(–16), ellipsoid, 9 by 4.5 mm.

description: Tree up to 15m high, dioecious; branches glabrous to pubescent. Leaves ovate to rotundate up to 4 by 8 cm diam, 9–11-nerved; bifid to ⅙–⅓ with broad sinus, tip of lobes broadly rounded; base truncate to cordate; upper surface glabrous, finely reticulate, lower glaucous (whitish when dry), glabrous to pubescent. Stipules linear, acute, 2–3 mm long, early caducous. Petioles glabrous to pubescent, 2–4 cm. Racemes short, compound, up to 5 cm long. Pedicels pubescent, filiform, 1–2 cm. Bracts minute, triangular; bracteoles diminutive. Buds club-shaped, pubescent, 6–10 mm long (♀ larger than ♂). Receptacle turbinate, 3–5 mm long (longer in the ♀). Calyx tubular, splitting into 3–5 segments in upper part. Petals white, oblong with very short claw, ca 10 mm long. ♂ flowers with 10 fertile stamens shorter than petals, outer whorl longer than inner filaments glabrous; anthers oblong, 2 mm. ♀ flowers: staminodes 10, minute. Ovary stipitate, densely tomentose, 5–6 mm long, with peltate stigma. Pods indehiscent, strap-shaped with long straight beak, glabrous, striate, 20–25 by l–l.5 cm. Seeds 10–30, oblong.
contributor: K. Larsen, S.S. Larsen, J.E. Vidal
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Large shrub or tree up to 15 m high; young branches rusty pubescent, later glabrous. Leaves broadly ovate to suborbicular, 7–20 cm in diam, 11–13-nerved; bifid ⅓–½ with narrow sinus, tip of lobes rounded-acute; base cordate to truncate; upper surface glabrous, lower pubescent on the nerves. Stipules triangular, acute, 3–6 mm long. Petioles 3–6 cm. Racemes shortly pubescent, few-flowered. Pedicels pubescent. 10–15 mm. Bracts lanceolate, ca 10 mm. long; bracteoles linear, 3–6 mm long, inserted at the base of receptacle. Buds fusiform, apex forming 5 minute, acute tips. Receptacle 2.5–3 cm long. Calyx tomentose, spathaceous, 1.5–2 cm long. Petals obovate, 4–5 cm long, gradually tapering towards the short claw; four petals creamy with pink streaks, the posterior one yellow with large, purple spots. Stamen 1 fertile; filament ca 4 cm long, hairy at the base; anther sagittate, 6 mm long; staminodes 9, ca 3 mm long. Ovary as long as the stamen, stipitate; style sparsely pubescent; stigma oblique, flattened. Pods dehiscent, linear, up to 20 by 2 cm, smooth. Seeds 10–20, fattened, black, shining, ca 1 cm diam.

description: Large, tendrilled climber; young branches brownish hirsute, later subglabrous. Leaves suborbicular up to 7 by 7.4 cm, 13–nerved; bifid to ⅓ with broad sinus, tip of lobes rounded; base shallowly cordate; upper surface glabrous, lower brownish hirsute. Stipules ovate-auriculate, ca 6 mm. Petioles brownish hirsute, 1.5–2.8 cm. Inflorescences lateral or terminal, lax panicles; axis brownish velvety. Pedicels 4–4.5 cm. Bracts lanceolate, 15 mm long, bracteoles similar, slightly smaller, inserted near the middle of the pedicel. Buds obovoid, slightly oblique, brownish tomentose, ca 2 cm. Receptacle tubular, striate ca 2 cm. Calyx splitting in 4 reflexed, subequal segments, 2–3.5 cm long. Petals white to yellowish, subequal, hairy particularly on the outer side, blade ovate-orbicular with cordate base, up to 2.5 cm; claw as long as or slightly shorter than blade. Stamens 3 fertile filaments ca 5 cm long, glabrous; anthers ca 1 cm long; staminodes 6, filiform, subequal up to 7 mm. Ovary stipitate, 10 mm, brownish tomentose; style ca 12 mm. tomentose; stigma peltate; ovules ca 10. Pods not seen from Thailand.

description: Bauhinia ornata is widely distributed from North-Eastern India through Burma, Northern Thailand to Laos, N. Vietnam and Southern China, it is an extremely polymorphic taxon, and a number of specie has been described within its variation range; some of these taxa are only known from the type locality. On basis of the meterial available from the total distribution range of the species we have found it reasonable to divide it into 5 varieties, of which 2 occur in Thailand, In some cases intermediate forms between the varieties have been observed; var. kerrii is the most widely distributed variety covering nearly the whole distribution range of the species.

description: Large, tendrilled climber; young branches rusty pubescent, later glabrous. Leaves ovate to rotundate, 10–15 pm diam, 11–13-nerved; bifid to ¼–⅓ with broad deltoid sinus, tip of lobes rounded to acute; base cordate; upper surface glabrous, lower ± pubescent. Leaves on adventitious shoots larger, deeply split sometimes consisting of 2 free leaflets, and often more hairy. Stipules falcate-ovate, 5 mm long, early caducuous. Petioles 5–10 cm. Flowers in dense, brownish pubescent corymbs. Pedicels tomentose, 1.5–4 cm. Bracts subulate, 5 mm; bracteoles minute inserted in the upper part of the pedicel. Buds ovoid to fusiform, brownish pubescent with pointed apex, 5–8 mm. Receptacle tubular, striate, ca 5 mm. Calyx splitting into 3–5 reflexed segments. Petals white turning creamy, obovate, hairy outside, up to 2 cm long including ca 5 mm long claw. Stamens 3 fertile; filaments pilose at base, slightly longer than petals; anthers elliptic, 2–3 mm; staminodes 0–4. Ovary densely brownish pilose, subsessile; style slender, glabrous towards stigma, up to 15 mm; stigma peltate. Pods unknown.

description: Tendrillcd shrub up to 2 m high with slender, reddish villous branches. Leaves ovate, 5–6 by 4–6 cm; 7–9-nervcd, bifid to ⅔–⅗ with rather broad sinus, tip of lobes subacute; base deeply cardate; upper surface glabrous, lower rusty red mainly on the nerves, soon subgiabrous. Stipules lanceolate, 2–3 mm long. Petioles woolly pubescent, 2–4 cm. Racemes reddish pubescent, lateral and terminal, mainly unbranched, lax-flowered, up to 15 cm long. Pedicels 1–2 cm. Bracts filiform, 5 mm long; bracteoles shorter, inserted below the middle of the pedicel. Buds fusiform, 4–5 mm long, apex with 5 free calyx teeth. Receptacle short, attenuate. Calyx splitting into 5 persistent, reflexed segments. Petals yellow, densely reddish hairy outside, lanceolate, acuminate, 4–5 mm long, short-clawed. Stamens 3 fertile; filaments 3–4 mm long; anthers elliptic-oblong, ca 1 mm long. Disc glabrous. Ovary glabrous, attached laterally to the disc, shortly stipitate, 2 mm long; style 1–2 mm; stigma inconspicuous. Pods dehiscent, glabrous, thin-valved, oblong, up to 6 by 2 cm, with a straight beak. Seeds unknown.

description: Shrub or large, straggling tree without tendrils; young branches pubescent, later glabrous. Leaves ovate to rotundate, 9–14 by 10–15 cm, 11–15-nerved; bifid ⅓(–½) with broad sinus, tip of lobes rounded; base cordate; upper surface brownish puberulous to glabrescent; lower surface rusty pubescent particularlyi on the nerves. Stipules minute, early caduceus. Petioles pubescent, 3–4 cm. Racemes lateral and terminal, up to 10 cm long. Pedicels 1–1.5 cm. Bracts triangular, 3–5 mm; bracteoles similar, inserted about the middle of the pedicel. Buds 3–4 cm long, elongate, reddish brown velvety. Receptacle tubular as long as bud. Calyx splitting up into 2–5-reflexed segments. Petals red with yellow centre, lanceolate, 4–6 cm long with claw shorter than blade; the posterior broader. Stamens 3 fertile; flaments glabrous, 3–4.5 cm; anthers linear, 10–12 mm; staminodes few (2), minute, subulate. Ovary 1–1.5, cm with a 1–2 cm long stipe; style 2–3 cm; stigma peltate, all reddish brown hirsute. Pods dehiscent, velvety, with thick dorsal suture, strap-shaped, broadest towards the acuminate, beaked apex. Seeds 4–6, flattened, orbicular, 1–1.5 cm diam.

description: Low shrub up to 1.5 m high; branches glabrous or nearly so. Leaves suborbicular, up to 17 cm in diam., 9–11-nerved, membranous; bifid to ⅕–⅓ with broad sinus, tip of lobes obtuse; base shallowly cordate; upper surface glabrous; lower subglabrous. Bracts short, subulate; bracteoles similar, inserted at the base of the pedicel. Buds oblong, shortly acuminate; appressed hairy, ca 1 cm long. Receptacle very short. Calyx spathaceous. Petals white, subequal, narrowly obovate, 15 mm long, short-clawed. Stamens 10 fertile, unequal; filaments sparsely pilose at base, unequal in length up to 8 mm long; anthers 2.5 mm long. Ovary? (only reduced ovary in ♂ flowers seen); stigma peltate. Pods dehiscent, linear, 10 by 1.5 cm. Seeds flat (mature seeds not seen).

description: Low, tendrilled climber, up to 5 m; young branches, grayish pubescent later glabrescent. Leaves ovate, up to 15 by 14 cm, 9–11-nerved, bifid to ½–⅔ with rather narrow sinus, tip of lobes acute, rarely obtuse; base deeply cordate; upper surface glossy, glabrous, lower glabrous to pubescent. Stipules falcate, ca 5 mm long. Petioles glabrescent, 2–4 cm. Racemes lateral and terminal, dense, pyramidal, up to 20 cm long. Pedicels pubescent, up to 1 cm. Bracts subulate, with broad triangular base, ca 1 cm long, surpassing the young buds; bracteoles linear, ca 5 mm long, inserted near the middle of the pedicel. Buds subglobose, silvery hairy, 8–10 mm long; receptacle indistinct. Calyx cup-shaped, not covering the. Corolla in bud, splitting during anthesis into 5 triangular segments. Petals greenish, hairy outside, narrowly ovate, with crenulate margins, ca 15 nim long including the ca 5 mm long claw, Stamens 3 fertile, filaments longer than the petals; anthers narrow, ca 3 mm long; staminodes 7, minute, subulate. Disc corrugated glabrous. Ovary velvety, ca 1 cm long on a 3–5 mm long stipe; style velvety, 5 mm; stigma inconspicuous. Pods dehiscent, woody-valved, flat, velvety, strap-shaped, up to 30 by 3.5 cm with a short straight beak. Seeds 10–20, flat, glossy, rectangular-orbicular, 10–15 mm diam.

description: Shrub or tree up to 10 m high; young branches glabrescent. Leaves suborbicular, up to 12 cm diam., 9–13-nerved; bifid to ⅓–½ with narrow to broad sinus, tip of lobes rounded to acute; base rounded to cordate; upper surface glabrous, lower sparsely hairy. Stipules minute, 1–2 mm long. Petioloes 2–3 cm. Racemes lateral or terminal, 6–10 flowered. Pedicels thick, 1–1.5 cm. Bracts ovate, acute, 1–2 mm long; bracteoies similar, inserted at about the middle of the pedicel. Buds clavate, velvety, greyish-green, 4–5 ang1ed mainly towards the ± twisted apex, ± 3–4 cm long. Receptacle 7–12 mm long. Calyx spathaceous. Petals pink to dark purple, narrowly lanceolate, the posterior broader, blanceolate, 3–5 cm long, claw 5–10 mm. Stamens 3 fertile; filaments shortly connate at base, 3–4 cm long; anthers 5–7 mm long; staminodus 5–6, thread-like, 6–10 mm long. Ovary velvety, 1 cm long, stipitate, stipe 1 cm; style short; stigma oblique, flat. Pods dehiscent, linear, 20–25 by 1.5–2.5 cm, glabrous, irregularly veined. Seeds ca 10, flat, orbicular, ca 15 mm diam.

description: Tree up to 15 m high; branches drooping, velvety when young, later nearly glabrous. Leaves reniform, 4–10 by 3–7 cm, 7–9-nerved; bifid to ⅕–¼ with very broad sinus, tip of lobes rounded; base truncate to deeply cordate; upper surface glabrous, lower greyish velvety to subglabrous. Stipules minute, triangular, early caducous. Petioles pubescent to subglabrous, 1–3 cm. Racemes pubescent, lateral, drooping, lax-flowered, up to 15 cm long. Pedicels ca 5 mm. Bracts minute; bracteoles diminutive, inserted near base of the pedicel. Buds pubescent, fusiform, ± falcate, with curved, pointed apex, 5–7 mm long. Receptacle turbinate, 2–3 mm long. Calyx spathaceous. Petals white-yellow, linear-lanceolate, slightly longer than calyx. Stamens 10 fertile, 5 outer ca 7 mm long, the inner shorter; filaments densely hairy at base; anthers narrow oblong, hairy, 3–4 mm. Ovary glabrous, 2 mm on an equally long stipe; stigma inconspicuous. Pods indehiscent, turgid, glabrous, 8–25 by 1.5–2.5 cm, ± falcate. Seeds 10–20, oval, ca 1 cm diam.

description: Tendrilled climber; all young parts rusty tomentose. Leaves ovate to subrotundate, 6–10 cm in diam., 9–11-nerved; bifid to ⅓–½ with rather narrow sinus, tip of lobes rounded; base truncate to cordate; upper surface brownish hirsute; lower rusty hirsute. Stipules ovate-lanceolate, falcate, 3 mm. Petioles densely hirsute, 2–3 cm. Racemes rusty, short, stout, dense-flowered. Pedicels stout, 3–5 mm. Bracts ovate, acute, 4–7 mm; bracteoles similar, smaller. Buds obovoid, ca 15 by 7 mm. Receptacle broadly cylindrical, slightly dilated at base, 8–10 mm long. Calyx eplitting into 5 free, ± reflexed sepals. Petals white, oblong, obtuse, 15–20 mm long, short clawed, densely silky tomentose outside. Stamens 3 fertile; filaments sparsely hairy, 2 cm long; anthers ca 7 mm long; staminodes 2, ca 1 cm. Ovary densely tomentose, 10–12 mm including the short stipe; style thick, 5 mm; stigma large, peltate. Pods uhknown.

description: Shrub or small tree sometimes straggling up to 10 m, normally dioecious; branches glabrous. Leaves broadly ovate, 5–9 by 6–10 cm, 9–11-nerved, chartaceous; bifid to ⅓–½ sinus narrow to broad, tip of lobes triangular-acute; base truncate to cordate; upper surface glabrous, lower sparsely pubescent with brownish glands. Stipules minute, early caducous. Petioles glabrous, 2–3 cm. Flowers clustered in dense-flowered, compound racemes up to ca 7 cm long. Pedicels 2–3 mm. Bracts minute, 1–2 mm; bracteoles similar, inserted below the middle of the pedicel. Buds ellipsoid, pubescent, 5–8 mm long, with short receptacle. Calyx spathaceous or splitting in two. Petals white to pinkish, narrow, obovate, with short claw, 7–10 mm. ♂ flowers with 10 fertile stamens, 5 outer ca 6 mm long, the inner half as long; anthers oblong, 1 mm. ♀ flowers with 10 filiform staminodes. Ovary hairy, 10 mm long including the short style and peltate stigma. Pods glabrous, dehiscent, strapshaped, broadest towards the apex with short, curved beak, 7–14 by 2–2.5 cm. Seeds 3–5, flattened, orbicular, 12–15 mm diam.

description: Tendrilled climber up to 14 m; branches glabrous. Leaves obovate, 8 by 6 cm, 9–11-nerved; bifid to ⅓–½with broad sinus, tip of lobes rounded, base cordate; both sides glabrous, lower pale. Stipules gladucous, not seen. Petioles glabrous, 1.5–2 cm. Racemes dense, terminal, up to 10 cm long, shortly brownish puberulous. Peclicels up to 10 mm long. Bracts lanceolate, 8–12 mm, acuminate; bracteoles linear, 7 mm, inserted above the middle of the pedicel. Buds 8–10 mm long, clavate, slightly falcate, apex ending with 5 short, free tips. Ovary reddish sericeous, 5 mm long on a 7 mm long stipe; style glabrous, 10 mm; stigma capitate. Pods dehiscent, flat, glabrous, 10 by 3 cm, narrowed towards base (only one young pod available).

description: Large, tendrilled climber; young greyish-brown velvety. Leaves broadly ovate to subrotundate, up to 9 by 9 cm, 11–13-nerved, bifid to ½–⅔ with narrow sinus, tip of lobes deltoid, obtuse; base slightly cordate; upper surface velutinous when young, later glabrous, lower pubescent. Calyx during anthesis splitting into 4(–5) ± reflexed segments, 15 mm long, Petals yellowish-green, subequal, blade narrow spatulate tapering towards the claw; 25–30 mm long (whole petal). Stamens 3 fertile; filaments red, 30–35 mm long; anthers 2–3 mm long; reduced stamens 7, with filaments up to 15 mm. Ovary pubescent, 6–10 mm on a 5–7 mm pubescent stipe, style as long as ovary; stigma peltate. Pods unknown.

description: Tendrilled climber up to 5 m; branches thin, glabrous. Leaves entire, ovate- oblong, 6–12 by 3–7 cm, 13–5-nerved; apex acuminate-emarginate to mucronate, base rounded to slightly cordate; both surfaces glabrous, Stipules falcate, 2–3 mm long, caducous. description: Erect shrub up to 3 m high; branches brownish pubescent. Leaves subrotundate, broader than long, 4–8 cm in diam, 7–9-nerved; bifid to ⅓–½ with broad sinus, tip of lobes rounded; base truncate to slightly cordate; upper surface glabrous, lower brownish pubescent. Pods dehiscent, velvety, linear, 7–15 by 1–1.5 cm. Seeds ca 5, flat, ca 1 cm diam.

description: Tendrilled climber; young branches greyish pubescent, later glabrous. Stamens 3 fertile; filaments slightly longer than the petals; anthers elliptic, 1.5–2 mm long; staminodes 7, minute, subulate. Ovary densely silky hairy, ca 6 mm long; style short glabrous; stigma oblique, discoid. Pods unknown.

description: Deciduous shrub or tree up to 15 m high; young branches pubescent, later glabrous. Leaves broadly ovate to subrotundate, 6–16 cm in diam., 11–13-nerved; bifid to ¼–⅓ with broad sinus, tip of lobes rounded; base cordate, upper surface glaucous, glabrous, lower sparsely puberulous. description: Shrub up to 4 m high; branches slender, glabrous. Leaves ovate-rotundate, 6–15 cm, 7–11-nerved; bifid to ⅓–⅔ with broad sinus; tip of lobes triangular, obtuse to acute, base truncate-cordate; upper surface glabrous, lower glabrescent or shortly pubescent on the nerves. Stipules triangular with setaceous tip, 2–3 mm; intrastipular trichome often developed into a curved, 2–3 mm long spine. Petioles 2–5 cm. Racemes lax-flowered, lateral and terminal, 5–15cm long, many-flowered. Pedicels 2–3 mm. Bracts subulate, 2–5 mm; bracteoles minute, Buds glabrous, ellipsoid of fusiform whether ovary develop or not, 6–10 mm including the very short receptacle. Calyx spathaceous. Petals greenish-white, obovate-lanceolate, 7–12 mm long. ♂ flowers with 10 fertile stamens shorter than the petals, 5 outer ones longest. Anthers oblong, glabrous, 1–2 mm. ♀ flowers with 10 unequal, reduced stamens. Ovary shortly stipitate, 6–8 mm; style very short; stigma peltate, all pubescent. Pods strap-shaped, 5–7 by 0.7–1 cm, glabrous; dehiscent. Seeds 6–10, flattened, 3 mm max. length.

description: Tendrilled climber; young branches rusty pubescent, later glabrous. Leaves consisting of 2 free, obliquely ovate leaflets with broad rounded ends, 3–4.5 by 1.5–2.5 cm, 3–4-nerved. Stipules minute. Petioles slender 1 cm. Racemes lateral and terminal, mainly unbranched with stout, rusty pubescent axis, up to 15 cm long. Pedicels stout, 4–8 mm. Calyx splitting into 5 free sepals. Petals 4 white, lanceolate-acute up to 9 by 4 cm including the 1.5 cm long claw; the posterior one yellowish, slightly shorter and broader. Stamens 10 fertile, filaments white, ca 7 cm long. Ovary stipitate, 4 cm long; style as long as ovary; stigma peltate. Pods tardily dehiscent, thin-valved, glabrous, slightly reticulate, up to 30 by 8 cm. Seeds 6–10(–more), compressed, glabrous, 10–15 mm diam.

description: Slender tendrilled climber or shrub; all vegetative parts glabrous. Leaves consisting of 2 free, bliquely ovate leaflets with broadly rounded ends, up to 6 by 3 cm, 4-nerved. Bracts subulale, 2 mm; bracteoles similar, smaller, inserted at about the middle of the pedicel. Buds glabrous, oblong, ca 8 mm long. Receptacle tubular, as long as the bud. Stamens 3 fertile, filaments 2.5 cm long; anthers 3 mm long; staminodes 7, 6–7 mm long. Ovary glabrous, 20 mm long including the 5 mm long stipe; stigma small, oblique. Pods dehiscent, rugulose, linear, up to 15 by 1.5 cm, acute at both ends, often slightly falcate. Seeds ca 10, flat, orbicular, 6 mm diam.

description: Climber armed with recurved prickles. Stipules scale-like, caducous. Pods sessile on the receptacle, elliptic-oblong, 8–10 by 2.5–3 cm, including the 4–8 mm wide wing; surfaces dull; receptacle persistent, laterally flattened, the dorsal and ventral edges recurved. description: Climber armed with straight or recurved prickles. Stipules pinnate consisting of 3–5 leaflets up to 2 cm. description: Herb or undershrub up to 60 cm high; all parts sticky through viscid hairs. Leaves with 2 pairs of leaflets. Stipules linear, acute, 24 mm long. Petioles 2.5–3.5 cm, rhachis 5–8 mm; a ligulate, acute gland between each pair of leaflets. Leaflets subsessile, very unequal-sided, 2–3 by 1–2 cm, rounded at both ends, pubescent on both sides. description: Tree up to 10 m high; young branches puberulous. Leaves with 6–7 pairs of leaflets. Stipules reniform, mucronate, 1 cm long. Petioles 1.5 cm, rhachis 10–15 cm. Leaflets with a 2–4 mm long petiolule, broadly elliptic, apex-rounded with acute to mucronulate tip, base rounded, both surfaces puberulous, 3.5–5.5 by 2.5–3 cm. Ovary puberulous, style stout, stigma inconspicuous. Pods terete, glabrcus, black with numerous seeds (mature pods not seen).

description: Shrub 1–2(–5) m high with pubescent, horizontally spread branches. Leaves with 8–20 pairs of leaflets. Petioles robust ca 2 cm; rhachis 30–60 cm. Ovary and style glabrous; stigma small. Pods thick, flattened, winged, glabrous, septate, 10–15 by 1.5–2 cm; wings 5 mm. Seeds ca 50, flattened, ± quadrangular, 7–10 by 5–8 mm.

description: Tree up to 10 m high; all younger parts densely hairy. Leaves with 5–7 pairs of leaflets; rhachis 15–40 cm, light-brown velvety pubescent as the 2–4 cm long petiole. Stipules narrow-lanceolate, pointed towards both ends, attached in the middle. Leaflets oblong-oblanceolate, 6–8 by 1.5–3 cm, both ends ± rounded; apex with a small sharp point; on both sides ± densely velvety hairy; petiolule 2 mm long. Racemes lateral, 5–12 cm long, 1–few together; main axis yellowish pubescent. Bracts lanceolate, apex long-pointed, hairy on both sides, 7–12 by 3 mm at base; bracteoles same shape but only ⅓ of the lenght. Flowers large (the largest Cassia flowers in Thailand) on a 6 cm, thinly pubescent pedicel, more densely hairy in a ring just below the calyx. Sepals ovate-lanceolate with acute apex, 9–12 by 2–3 mm, hairy on both surfaces. Petals ovate-lanceolatc, pinkish, 3.5–4.5 by 1–2.5 cm with a 5 mm long, narrow claw. Stamens 10; 3 long with filaments 3.5–5 cm long, swollen in the middle, anthers 5 mm long, ovoid, opening by apical and basal slits; 4 with filaments only half the length but with anthers nearly twice as long, opening by slits; reduced stamens 3 small, with filaments 1–1.5 cm long and very small anthers. Ovary 4 cm long, recurved, on a 1–1.5 cm long stipe, white pubescent with a subapical, punctiform stigma. Pods terete, softly grey to brownish velvety pubescent, 30–40 cm long, 1–1.5 cm diam. Seeds 30–40, separated by spongy septa.

description: Glabrous shrub up to 3 m high. Leaves with 3 pairs of leaflets, the upper pairs largest. Petioles 1–3 cm; rhachis 1–2 cmwith clavate glands between the 2 lowermost leaflets. Stipules linear-acute, caduceus, 3 mm. Leaflets obovate, ± unequal-sided, 15–30 by 10–15 mm; apex rounded, sometimes with a short mucro; base obliquely cuneate; petiolules short. Flowers in slender racemes, 5–15 cm long in the upper leaf axils. Peduncle 2–3 cm. Bracts linear–acute, 1–2 mm long, caducous; bracteoles minute, early caducous. Pedicels 2–8 mm. Receptacle 2 mm long. Sepals ovate, 8–10 mm long. Petals yellow, obovate, 12–15 mm long. Stamens 10, 2 long with filaments up to 10 mm long, anthers 7 mm long, curved, opening with apical pores and slits; 5 shorter subequal with filaments 1–2 mm long, anthers 4–7 mm opening by pores; reduced stamens 3, subsessile with very small, anthers. Ovary and style normally glabrous; stigma small. Pods inflated, cylindrical, brown, glabrous, indehiscent, 15–20 cm long; 1.5 cm diam, septate. Seeds 40–60, olive green, flattened, ovate, 8 mm across.

description: Tree, rarely above 10–15 m high with glabrous branches. Leaves with 3–8 pairs of leaflets, large. Petioles 7–10 cm; rhachis 15–25 cm. Leaflets ovate-oblong, 7–12 by 4–8 cm, glabrous when mature; petiolules 5–10 mm. Stipules small, caduceus. Racemes axillary, few together, pendent, lax, 20–40 cm long. Pedicels glabrous, 15–35 mm. Bracts 8–10 mm long, caduceus. Sepals ovatc-elliptic, velutinous outside, 7–10 mm long. Petals yellow, ovate, 30–35 by 10–15 mm, subequal, short-clawed. Stamens 10; 3 long ones with filaments 3 cm long, anthers 5 mm long opening by apical and basal slits; 4 shorter with filaments 8–10 mm long, anthers opening by a basal pore; reduced stamens 3 with filament 5 mm long and minute anthers. Ovary and style velutinous; stigma small. Pods terete, glabrous, black, 20–60 cm long, 1.5–2 cm diam., with numerous seeds separated by spongy septa. Seeds elliptic, flattened, glossy brown, 8–9 by 5 mm.

description: Shrub or small tree up to 4 m high; young part gleyish puberulous. Leaves with 2 pairs of leaflets. Stipules linear, acute, 2–4 mm long. Petioles 2–5 cm; rhachis 1–2.5 cm with 1 obtuse gland between the lower pair of leaflets; petiolules short. Leaflets very unequal-sided, oblique-ovatc, apex acute, base cuneate, upper surface glabrous, lower puberulous; upper pairs larger, 4–10(–15) by 2–4(–7) cm. Racemes short, towards the ends of the branches, in leafy panicles. Bracts linear, 2–3 mm long, early caducous; bracteoles cup-shaped, enclosing the bud. Pedicels 3–5 mm (enlarging in fruit). Sepals pubescent oblong, subequal, ca 1 cm long. Petals broadly ovate, 2–3 by 2 cm, with a 1–3 mm long claw. Fertile stamens 7, 3 with filaments 3–4 mm long, slender; 4 with stouter filaments, anthers subequal, curved, thick, opening by terminal pores, 7–10 mm long; staminodes. 2–3 normally present, flattened towards apex, 3–4 mm long. Ovary appresscd pubescent. Pods terete, slight1y annulate, with flat raised margin, 15–25 cm long, 1 cm- diam. Seeds numerous embedded in a sticky pulp.

description: Tree up to 10 m high; branches puberulous, later glabrous. Leaves with 6–9 pairs of leaflets. Petioles 4–5 cm long; rhachis 10–20 cm long. Stipules early caduceus (not seen). Leaflets lanceolate to broadly ovate, acuminate with rounded base, 5–9 by 2–5 cm, glabrous or nearly so; petiolules 4–6 mm. Inflorescences terminal, leafy, compound racemes, 9–20 cm long, many-flowered; axis densely yellowish velutinous. Pedicels 3 cm, pubescent. Bracts ovate, acute, caducous, 4 mm long; bracteoles minute. Sepals unequal, 2 outer smaller, ca 5 mm long, 3 inner twice as long, broadly elliptic, puberulous outside. Petals yellow, obovate, 15–18 mm long, with a 4 mm long claw. Stamens 10, 2 largest with flattened filaments, 7 mm long, anthers 7–9 mm long curved, opening by apical pores; 5 shorter with smaller anthers; reduced stamens 3, ca 2 mm long. Ovary and style glabrous or puberulous along the margin; stigma indistinct. Pods flat, glabrous, thin-valved, 15–22 by 2–4 cm, often twisted. Seeds ca 20, 9 by 5 mm, brownish.

description: Deciduous tree (see below) up to 20 m high with buttressed trunk; young branches and inflorescence covered with short brownish to white wool. Leaves with 10–20 pairs of leaflets. Petioles 2–3 cm, woolly; rhachis 10–25 cm. Stipules minute. Leaflets with short petiolule, subcoriaceous, elliptic-oblong, 3–5 by 1–2 cm, upper surface glossy, lower woolly; apex and base rounded. Racemes lateral, 10–20 cm long with on 20 flowers. Bracts ovate, acute, 5 mm long, caduceus; bracteoles smaller inserted at base of the 1–2 cm long pedicel. Sepals pubescent on both sides, obovate, rounded, 5–8 min long, finally reflexed. Petals obovate, 15 mm long, short-clawed, first red, later pink, finally orange. Stamens 10; 3 long with recurved filaments, 3 cm long, anthers pubescent, 2.5 mm long, opening by apical large and smaller, basal slits; 5 shorter with straight filaments and smaller anthers; 2 reduced stamens 2 mm long. Ovary silky tomentose; style short; stigma small. Pods woody, rugose, glabrous, compressed-cylindric, blackish, 20–40 cm long, 3–4 cm diam. Seeds 20–40.

description: Herb or undershrub up to 2.5 m high, hirsute, with a foetid smell. Leaves with 4–5 pairs (rarely more or less) of subopposite or opposite leaflets. Petioles 5–6 cm, villous with a sessile, oblong gland above the joint; rhachis 7–10 cm. Stipules linear, acute, hairy, ± caduceus, 5–15 mm long. Leaflets lanceolate-acuminate, 5–9 by 2–3 cm, hirsute on both surfaces; apex acute, base rounded; the upper pairs largest; petiolules short. Racemes few-flowered, short, from the upper leaf-axils. Bracts 4–5mm long, hirsute. Flowers on a 1–2 cm pubescent, filiform pedicel. Sepals unequal; 2 outer small, orbicular, 5–6 mm; 3 inner larger, 7–9 mm. Petals yellow, unequal, obovate, 15–28 mm long, glabrous, short-clawed. Stamens 10, 2 large with flat filaments 5–7 mm long, anthers curved, 7–8 mm, opening by apical pores; 4 smaller opening the same way; reduced stamens 4, 3 mm long. Ovary grayish woolly, recurved; style glabrous; stigma slightly enlarged, ciliate. Pods falcate to nearly straight, 6–13 by 0.5 cm, hirsute, angulate. Seeds numerous dark olive, orbicular, ca 3 mm diam.

description: Deciduous tree up to 15 m high; young specimens with the trunk armed with stumps of branches; branches nearly glabrous. Leaves with 5–15 pairs of leaflets. Stipules falcatc to pointed, elliptic, attached in the middle. Petiole 1.5–4 cm, nearly glabrous; rhachis 20–30 cm. Leaflets on a short petiolule, elliptic-ovate to oblong, 2.5–5 by 1.5–2.5 cm, apex rounded to blunt, base usually broadly rounded; upper surface feebly shining lower dull, finely appressed pubescent. Racemes arising laterally from the branches, forming a corymb, patent or deflexed, 5–16 cm long. Peduncle 2–3 cm. Bracts ovate-acute, 10–15 mm long; bracteoles axillary, linear oblong, 4–5 mm long. Pedicel 3–5 cm. Sepals ovate-acutce, dark red to reddish brown, 7–10 mm. Petals first pink later dark red, finally pale, obovate, 25–35 by 7–8 mm with a 3 mm long claw. Stamens 10; 3 long recurved with a spherical enlargement near the middle of the 20 mm long filament, anthers 4 mm long opening by apical and basal slits; 4 shorter ones ca 10 mm long with larger anthers opening by basal pores; reduced stamens 3 ca 10 mm long with minute anthers. Ovary pubescent, slender, recurved on a thin stipe; stigma indistinct. Pods terete, glabrous, black, indehiscent, 20–60 cm long, 1–1.5 cm diam. Seeds 50–75, glossy corky, brown, flat, ± orbicular, embedded in a flat disc.

description: Deciduous tree up to 20 m high, always with an unarmed trunk. Differs from subsp. javanica in normally having fewer leaflets (5–12 pairs) with an acute apex. The inflorescence rhachis is normally more slender. The petals are smaller. In living specimens the green calyx is an easy distinguishing character.

description: Herb with woody base or low shrub up to 1 m, erect or decumbent; branches appressed pubescent. Leaves with 20–80 pairs of leaflets; leaves and leaflets sensitive to touch. Stipules persistent, linear, acute, 5–10 mm. Petioles 3–10 mm with a flat, discoid, sessile gland just below the lowest pairs of leaflets; rhachis not canaliculate, serrate or crenate-crested along upper side, sparsely pubescent, 3–10 cm. Leaflets sessile, very unequal-sided, with ± parallel sides, (2–)4–8 by 1 mm (median ones), glabrous, sparsely ciliate along the margins; apex acute mucronate; base oblique truncate. Flowers axillary, mostly solitary, sometimes 2–3 together in a very short raceme. Bracts lilo: the stipules; bracteoles smaller. Pedicels pubescent, 5–10 mm. Sepals lanceolate, 4–8 mm long. Petals bright yellow, short-clawed, obovate to orbicular, equal to or slightly longer than the sepals. Stamens 7–10, fllaments 1–2 mm anthers straight, varying in length, 2–4 mm long, opening by apical pores. Ovary covered with short, stiff, appressed hairs; style glabrous, recurved; stigma flat, ciliate. Pods flat, strap-shaped, dehiscent, with scattered appressed hairs to nearly glabrous, 3–6 by 0.5 cm. Seeds 10–20, brown, smooth, flat, 4 by 2 mm.

description: Herb or undershrub up to 150(–250) cm, ± glabrous. Leaves with (3–)4(–5) pairs of leaflets. Petioles 3–4 cm long with a relatively large, ovoid gland just above the petiole joint; rhachis 8–12 cm. Stipules linear-acute, ± falcate, 1–2 cmlong. Leaflets membranous, ovate-oblong, ± unequal-sided, 4–10 by 2–3 cm, apex acuminate, base rounded; petiolues 2 mm. Racemes short-peduncled, 2–4-flowered, mainly terminal. Bracts linear-acute, caducous. Pedicels 5–10 mm. Sepals unequal, outer ones orbicular, 6 mm diam., inner ovate, larger. Petals yellow with violet veins, 2 outer slightly larger, 1–2 by 1.5 cm, short-clawcd. Stamens 9–10, 2 long with filaments 5–6 mm long, anthers 5–7 mm long, opening by apical pores; 4 with filaments 2–3 mm long and anthers 5–6 mm long, opening the same way; reduced stamens 3–4 with filaments 1–2 mm long and minute anthers. Ovary tomentose; style glabrous; stigma lateral, small. Pods flattened, glabrous, brown with pale margins, 10–12 by 1 cm. Seeds 30–40, flat, orbicular, 3–4 mm diam.

description: Herb with woody base or low shrub, rarely above 50 cm, procumbent, sometimes erect; branches pubescent. Leaves with 10–25 pairs of leaflets; leaves and leaflets sensitive to touch. Stipules persistent, linear acute, 5–10 mm long. Petioles 3–7 mm, pubescent with, a long-stipitate gland below the lowest pair of leaflets; rhachis grooved in side view, pubescent, 2–5 cm long. Leaflets sessile, unequal-sided with ± parallel sides, 7–12 by 2–3 mm, glabrous or with few hairs along the midrib, apex rounded, with a long mucro. Flowers supra-axillary, solitary or more often 2–3 together in a very short raceme. Bracts and bracteoles as the stipules but shorter. Pedicels pubescent, 4–6 mm. Sepals lanceolate, acute, 5–6 mm long. Petals bright yellow, unequal, oblong–obovate, 2–3 mm long, short-clawed. Stamens 5, subequal; filaments 1–1.5 mm; anthers straight, 1.5–2 mm long, opening by apical pores enlarging into a short slit. Ovary appressed tomentose; style glabrous, recurved; stigma small, peltate. Pods flat, strap-shaped, dehiscent, thinly pubescent, 2–5 by 0.5 cm. Seeds 10–15, brown, smooth, flat, subrhomboidal, 3 mm long.

description: Medium-sized tree; young branches striate, finely pubescent. Leaves with 7–10(–15) pairs of leaflets. Petiole 2–3 cm; rhachis 10–25 cm long. Stipules minute, subulate, caduceus. Leaflets on a short petiolule, ovate-oblong, base rounded, apex rounded or emarginate with a short, mucronate tip, glabrous on upper surface, ± finely pubescent on lower, 3–7 by 1–2 cm. Flowers in large terminal panicles on a robust 5–7 cm long peduncle. Bracts olbovate with long acute apex, 5 mm long; bracteoles absent. Pedicels 2–3 cm, velutinous. Sepals 5, orbiculat, thick, unequal, 2 outer small, 5 mm long, 3 inner up to 9 mm long, hairy on the outer side. Petals yellow, broadly obovate, 1.5–2 cm long, short clawed. Stamens 10, 2 with filaments 10 mm long and 6–7 mm long, straight anthers opening by apical pores; 4–5 with filaments 2–4 mm long and anthers 5–6 mm opening the same way; reduced stamens 3, ca 2–4 mm. Ovary finely pubescent; style glabrous; stigma indistinct. Pods flat, glabrescent, longitudinally waved with raised sutures, 20–30 by 1–1.5 cm. Seeds 20–30, flat, oval, light brown, 10–15 by 5–6 mm.

description: Shrub 1–3 m high, dearly glabrous. Leaves with 4–9 pairs of relatively narrow leaflets. Petioles 3–5 cmlong with a thin, subulate gland, 0.5–1 cm above the petiole joint; rhachis 9–1 5 cm. Stipules ovate, caducous, ca 5 mm long. Leaflets membranous, lanceolate; apex acute, base rounded, 2–5(–8) by 1–2 cm, the upper leaflets largest. Flowers in axillary, few-flowered corymbs. Bracts ovate, ca 5 mm long. Peduncle 1–2 cm; pedicels 1–1.5 m; bracteoles absent. Sepals ovate-rounded, 5 mm long. Petals yellow, obovate, 10–14 by 7 mm, short-clawed. Stamens 9–10, 2 long with filaments 5–7 mm long, anthers 5–6 mm long, curved, opening by apical pores; 4 shorter with filaments 2 mm long and anthers 5 mm long, opening the same way; reduced stamens 3–4 ca 2 mm. Ovary finely pubescent; style thin, glabrous; stigma slightly swollen. Pods ± swollen, straight or nearly so, 10 by 0.5–1 cm, glabrous. Seeds 30–40, ovoid, compressed, ca 4 mm long.

description: Small tree up to 7 m high with long, spreading leafy branches; young parts softly pubescent. Leaves with 10–15 pairs of leaflets. Petioles 3–4 cm, rhachis 20–30 cm. Stipules linear, falcate, early caducous, 1 cm long. Leaflets with short petiolule, narrow elliptic, 3–7 by 1–2 cm, base rounded, apex acute, mucronate; upper surface glabrous, lower finely appressed pubescent. Inflorescences large, terminal, leafy panicles, 20–30 cm. Bracts ovate, 4.5 mm long, caducous. Pedicels 2–3 cm, velutinous. Sepals unequal, 2 outer pubescent; 3 inner glabrous, larger, 5–7 mm long. Petals yellow, spathulate, short-clawed, the lower one larger, broad falcate, 2–2.5 mm long. Stamens 10; 7 large with filaments 2–3 cm long, anthers opening by apical poresand a slit; reduced stamens 3, with reniform anthers much smaller. Ovary glabrous, recurved; style and stigma inconspicuous. Pods ± terete glabrous, glossy, black, annulate septate, 18–25 by 1 cm. Seeds 50–70, suborbicular, pointed at one end, 5 mm diam; septa papery.

description: Small tree up to 10 m high; young branches and leaves varying in indumentum from nearly glabrous to yellowish and golden hairy. Leaves with 10–20 pairs of leaflets. Petioles 1–2 cm ;rhachis 20–30 cm, pubescent. Stipules large, auriculate, 1.5–2.0, cm long. Leaflets with short ยetiolule, oblong, 2–6 by 1–1.5 cm with rounded base and subacute to mucronate apex, from nearly glabrous to yellowish pubescent on both sides. Inflorescences axillary, dense racemes, 10–30 cm long; axis ± glabrous to yellowish, pubescent. Bracts caduceus, ovate, acute up to 20 by 15 mm. Pedicels 1–3 cm, pubescent. Sepals unequal, oblong-ovate with rounded apex, 7–15 mm long, yellowish pubescent outside. Petals yellow, obovate, short-clawcd, 15–20 by 10–15 mm. Stamens 10, 2 largest with filaments 2–4 mm long, anthers 8–10 mm long opening by apical pores; 5 somewhat smaller opening the same way; reduced stamens 3, ca 2 mm. Ovary ± glabrous; style glabrous; stigma inconspicuous. Pods flat glabrous, dehiscent, 8–16 by 1–1.5 cm. Seeds 10–30, elliptic, glossy, flattened, 7 by 5 mm.

description: Herb or undershrub up to 1 m high, nearly glabrous. Leaves with 3 pairs of leaflets. Petioles 1–4 cm; rhachis 2–3 cm with a subulate, 2 mm long gland between the 2 lower pairs of leaflets. Stipules setaceous, 10–15 mm long, ± caducous. Leaflets increasing in size distally with a short petiolule, membranous, obovate; apex broadly rounded, base cuneate-rounded, 2–5 by 1.5–2 cm. Racemes axillary, short, 1–3-flowered. Bracts linear acute, 2–3 mm long. Pedicels 4–10 mm (enlarging in fruit). Sepals subequal, ovate, 5 by 2–4 mm. Petals yellow, unequal, obovate, short-clawed with rounded apex, up to 10 by 6 mm. Stamens 7, nearly equal; filaments 1.5–2 mm; anthers 1.5–2.5 mm long, opening by apical pores; reduced stamens absent. Ovary densely pubescent; style glabrous with truncate apex (stigma). Pods terete, linear, ± falcate, 10–15 by 0.5 cm. Seeds 20–30, glossy, rhomboidal, 5 mm diam.

description: Tree up to 10 m high; twigs densely rusty-tomentose when young, glabrescent. Leaves: rhachis 4–10 cm long, densely rusty-tomentose, produced beyond the upper petiolule into a more or less persistent tip up to 10 mm long; leaflets 5–7, the lower ovate, the upper oblanceolate to elliptic-obovate, 6.5–16 by 2.5–4 cm, narrow and long acuminate-caudate at the tip, subcotdate to cuneate at the base, shining and glabrous above, dull and rusty-tomentose on the nerves beneath; lateral nerves 6–8 pair , meeting in a looped intramarginal vein; petiolules ± 2.5 mm. Racemes densely rusty-tomentose, ca 10 cm long. Pedicels 8–10 mm long, rusty-tomentose. Sepals oblong, 5–6 mm long (when reflexed), rusty-tomentose outside, glabrous inside. Stamens not seen. Ovary densely rusty-velvety, 1-ovulate. Pods (young) linear-oblong, 5 by 2 cm, densely shortly rusty-pubesceent. Seed 1.

description: Tree 8–25 m high; twigs appressed greyish pubescent, becoming glabrous. Leaves: rhachis 4–8 cm long, glabrous to sparsely pubescent; leaflets 4–6, ovate, 3–8 by 2–5 cm, acuminate-obtuse at the tip, rounded at the base, glabrous to sparsely pubescent above, downy becoming glabrous beneath; nerves 8–10 pairs, meeting in a looped intramarginal vein; petiolules 2–3 mm long. Inflorescence in spike-like axillary greyish downy racemes, 5–15 cm long. Pedicels 3–4 mm, greyish downy. Sepals ovate-obtuse, 3–4 mm long, glabrous outside, ± hairy inside. Stamens 8–10, exserted. Ovary ± 3mm high, densely hairy, 3–5-ovulate. Pods elliptic, 5–6 by 3–4 cm, transversely veined, velvety-tawny. Seed 1(–2), suborbicular to elliptic, 3 by 2.5 cm, brown.

description: Slender shrub or tree, up to 5 m high. Leaves: rhachis 2–8 cm long, glabrous; leaflets 3–4, elliptic or obovate, 10–20 by 3.5–8 cm, blunt acuminate at the tip, rounded or shortly narrowed at the base, glabrous; nerves 6–10 pairs, joined in a looped intramarginal vein; petiolules 5 mm long. Inflorescences in axillary, scurfy-velvety racemes, 5 cm long. Flowers densely arranged. Pedicels 1–2 mm, velvety. Sepals ± 4 mm long, velvety. Stamens 10. Ovary densely woolly, 6-ovulate. Pods elliptic, 6–10 by 3.5–4 cm, acute at the top, unequally rounded at the base, transversally veined, rusty-velvety. Seeds 1–2, kidney-shapcd, 3–4 by 2–3 cm, brown.

description: Shrub 3–5 m high or tree up to 25 m; branches glabrous. Leaves: rhachis 1–3 cm long, glabrous; leaflets 3, elliptic-lanceolate, 7–18 by 2–9 cm, cuspidate at the tip, shortly narrowed at the base, glabrous; lateral nerves ca 6 pairs, meeting in a looped intramarginal vein; petiolules 3–4 mm. Racemes 8–15(–30) cm long, glabrous. Flowers dense or, sparse. Pedicels ca 1 mm, glabrous. Sepals oblong, 2–3 mm long, glabrous. Stamens 6–9. Ovary woolly hairy, 1–3-ovulate. Pod unknown.

description: Tree about 20 m high; twigs glabrous or the youngest pubescent. Leaves: rhachis 5–8 cm long, glabrous; leaflets 3–6, oblong-lanceolate to obovate, 6–12 by 2.5–4.5 cm, acuminate at the tip, rounded to cuneate at the base, glabrous (sparsely pubescent on the midrib beneath when young); nerves 6–10 pairs, meeting in a looped intramarginal vein; petiolules 3–5 mm. Flowers rather dense in sparsely pubescent, 10–20 mm long, racemes. Pedicels 3–6 mm, appressedly pubescent. Sepals ovate-obtuse, 3–4 mm long, sparsely pubescent outside, glabrous inside. Stamens 10. Ovary ± 3 mm, densely hairy, 2–4-ovu1ate. Pods obliquely elliptic, ca 6 by 4 cm, transversely veined, rusty-velvety.

description: A handsome tree with slender pendulous, glabrous branches and glabrescent new shoots. Leaves: rhachis 5–7.5 cm long, glabrous or sparsely finely pubescent; leaflets 5 (rarely 3), ovate, 5–6 by 2.5–3.5 cm, shortly and bluntly acuminate at the tip, unequally rounded or truncate at the base, glabrous or sparsely pubescent beneath: nerves 6–8, meeting in a looped intramarginal vein; petiolules 3–4 mm. Inforescences in rather dense narrow racemes at the ends of new leafy shoots, 15–25 cm long, with glabrescent rhachis. Pedicels slender, 6–8 mm long, glabrous or flnely appressedly puberulous. Sepals sparsely puberulous externally, glabrous within. Stamens 10. Ovary densely hairy, 1–2-ovulate. Pod unknown.

description: Tree up to 15 m high, usually smaller. Leaves with 1–2 pairs of leaflets, leaf-rachis shorter than 4 cm. Petiole 2–8 mm, glabrous to pubescent. Leaflets subsessile, ovate to ovate-lanceolate, 5.5–16 by 2–6 cm, apex obtuse-acuminate, emarginate. Racemes fascicled, cauliflorous; rachis up to 3 cm long. Bracts 3–7 mm long, ciliate; bracteoles 1–2 mm long. Pedicels 3–7 mm long, pubescent to glabrous. Receptacle 1–2 mm long. Sepals 4 (rarely 5), 2–4 mm long. Petals 3–4 mm long. Stamens normally 10. Ovary densely hairy, subsessile; style 5–6 mm, hairy on lower half. Pods fleshy, rugose, glabrescent, 3–5 by 2–3 cm.

description: Tree 20–25 m high. Leaves with 1 pair of leaflets. Petiole g1abrous to pubescent, 5–7 mm. Leaflets ovate to oblong or falciform, 4.5–6.5 by 2–3 cm, apex acute to, cuspidate-acuminate. Racemes axillary, rachis 1–4 mm, glabrous. Bracts broader than long, ciliate, 2 mm; bracteoles smaller, glabrous. Pedicels 3 mm, glabrous. Receptacle 1 mm. Sepals 2–3 mm long, glabrous. Petals about the same size. Stamens 2–3 mm long. Ovary glabrous, shortly stipitate; style short. Pods glabrous with lateral beak; pericarp paper–thin, 5 by 3 cm.

description: Shrub to small tree up to 8 m high. Leaves with 1–2 pairs of accrescent leaflets. Petiole hairy, 5 mm; rachis 10–12 mm. Leaflets on short petiolules, ovate-elliptic to oblong, 2–9 by 1–4 cm, apex rounded, emarginate (mucronate). Racemes short, axillary; axis 3–4 mm, densely pubescent. Bracts 1 mm, glabrescent; bracteoles slightly longer. Pedicels 4–6 mm, patently short hairy. Receptacle 1mm. Sepals 4–5 reflexed but with apex curled up, 3–4 mm long. Petals shorter, 3 mm broad. Stamens 3–5 mm. Ovary shortly stipitate, patehtly long-hairy inside; sty1e 3–4 mm, glabrous, lateral. Pods woody-valved, deeply rugose, with a lateral beak (persistent style), 1–2 cm largest diam.

description: Tree up to 40 m high. Leaves with 2–3 pairs of leaflets, leaf-rachis at least 5 cm. Petiole 3–4 mm, rachis 5–6 cm. Leaflets ovate-oblong to oblong, 4–8.5 by 2–3 cm; lapex acuminate, emarginate. Racemes axillary, 2–3 cm long. Bracts 2–9 mm long, tomentosa to glabrescent; bracteoles 3–4 mm long. Pedicels tomentose, 3–4 mm long. Receptacle 1–2 mm. Sepals 3–4 mm long. Petals 2–4 mm long. Stamens up to 6 mm long. Ovary sericeous villous, shortly stipitate; style 1–3 mm, curved at anthesis, later straight. Pods arcuate ovoid, flat, smooth, 4–5 cm diam.

description: Tree up to 30 m high. Leaves with 1–2 pairs of leaflets. Petiole 3–5 mm; rachis 1.5–7 cm, glabrous to pubescent. Leaflets on very short petiolules, varying in shape from nearly orbicular to elliptic (proximal) to oblong-lanccolate (distal), lower leaf- lets 2–6 by 0.5–3 cm, upper 5–20 by 3–7 cm, apex acute to acuminate. Racemes axillary, 15–25 mm long. Bracts 3–10 mm long, glabrescent to hairy; bracteoles 3–4 mm long. Pedicels 7–15 mm, glabrous to pubescent. Receptacle 1 mm. Sepals 4, unequal, 3–4 mm long, glabrous to hairy. Petals 5–8 mm long, lanceolate. Stamens 10 (rarely more). Ovary densely hairy, shortly stipitate; style 5 min with few hairs on lower part; Pods ovate-elliptic, with shallowly rugose to undulated surface and subterminal beak, 2–5 by 1–4 cm.

description: Deciduous tree up to 15 m high (rarely more); bark grey, smooth. Leaves bipinnate, main rachis 50–60 cm long with 9–24 pairs of opposite, up to 10 cm long, secondary rachises. Leaflets 14–30 on the middle rachis, sessile, oblong with rounded apex, glabrous with slightly oblique base, 8–10 by 3–4 mm. Stipules cadueous, ± 2 mm long. Inflorescence 10–15 cm long, glabrous with 5–10 flowers. Pedicels 5–8 cm. Buds obovate. Receptacle campanulate, short. Sepals oblong-acuminate, reddish on the inside, 2–2.5 by 4–7 mm. Petals unequal, orange-red, 3–5 by 3–4 cm including a 2–3 cm long, reddish claw and orbicular blade. Stamens 10 equal in length, filaments 4 cm long, red with white base; anthers 4 mm long. Ovary green, slightly velutinous; style filiform, glabrous, 2.5 cm; stigma indistinct. Pods slightly curved, woody-valved, pendulous, blackish, terminated by the persistent style, 30–60 by 4–5 cm. Seeds 20–40, compressed, oblong-elliptic, up to 25 by 6 mm.

description: Tree 15–25 m high. Leaves: rhachis 5–10 cm long, glabrous; leaflets 5–9, alternate, broadly ovate to elliptic, 4–7 by 1.5–4.5 cm, obtuse to acuminate at the tip, rounded to acute at the base, glabrous or glabrescent; lateral nerves 6–10 pairs, joined together near the margin; petiolules 4–5 mm. Panicles 10–30 cm long; branches pubescent; Pedicels ± 2 mm, pubescent. Buds ovoid, 3–4 mm long. Sepals elliptic, ± 4 mm long, grey pubescent outside, glabrous inside. Stamens: filaments very short (± 1 mm); anthers oblong, ± 3 mm long. Ovary silky; style glabrous; stigma small. Pods ovoid 15 by 10 by 8 mm, finely pubescent to velvety. Seed solitary, elliptic, 9 by 6 by 3 mm, longitudinally striate.

description: Tree 20–25 m high. Leaves: rhachis 10–20 cm long, puberulous; leaflets 5–9, alternate or subopposite, ovate-oblong to ovate-lanceolate, 7–10 by 2.5–3 cm, shortly obtuse acumiuate at the tip, cuneate at the base, glabrous; lateral nerves 8–10 pairs, joined together near the margin; petiolules 4–5 mm. Panicles terminal and axillary, ca 10 cm long; branches faintly puberulous. Pedicels 3–4 mm, puberulous. Buds oblong in outline, 4–5 mm long. Sepals ovate-oblong, obtuse, 5–6 mm long, grey puberulous on both surfaces. Stamens: filaments very short (ca 1 mm); anthers oblong, 4–5 mm long. Ovary silky; style glabrous; stigma flattened. Pods suborbicular 20–30 by 15–20, by 8 mm, when young finely grey puberulous, afterwards glabrous and black. Seed solitary, obovate-quadrate, 10–15 by 10–12 by 3.5 mm, longitudinally striate.

description: Tree 10–30 m high. Leaves: rhachis ca 10 cm long, puberulous; leaflets 5–7, alternate or sub-opposite, elliptic-oblong to ovate lanceolate, 8–15 by 3–5 cm; caudate blunt acuminate at the tip, rounded or cuneate at the base, yellowish-brown pubescent beneath; lateral nerves 9–11 pairs; petiolules ca 6 mm. Panicles 12–20 cm long; branches brown silky. Pedicels ca 2 mm, pubescent. Buds ovoid, ca 6 mm long. Sepals ovate triangular; blunt, 5–6 mm long, brown velvety on both sides. Stamens: filaments ca 2 mm long; anthers triangular, ca 3.5 mm. Ovary black velvety; style brown velvety, except at the top; stigma small. Pods obovoid or sphaerical, up to 25 mm long and 15–20 mm across, persistently dark brown velvety. Seed orbicular, 10–15 mm in diameter, pale brown, striate.

description: Tree with red sap. Leaves: rhachis 12–18 cm long, pubescent; pinnae 2–3 pairs, the rhachis 10–20 cm long, pubescent; leaflets 8–10, ovate, 6–8 by 4–5 cm, obtuse, sometimes emarginate at the tip, rounded unequal or slightly cordate at the base, pubescent; petiolule ca 2 mm. Flowers sessile in axillary spikes, sometimes branched at base, tomentose, 8–10 cm long. Receptacle pubescent, ca 1 mm long. Sepals oblong, rounded at the top, ca 1 mm, ciliate at margin. Petals linear-spathulate, 3 by 0.3. mm, ciliate at margin. Stamens with glabrous filaments; anthers with brown margin. Ovary on ca 1 mm stipe, hirsute; ovules 6–10. Pods ca 5 mm stipitate, 15–18 by 2.5–3 cm. Seeds 5–8, 12–14 by 8–9 mm; funicle ca 6 mm long.

description: Tree up to 30 m high. Leaves: rhachis 10–50 cm long, glabrous; pinnae 2–4 pairs, the rhachis 10–30 cm long; leaflets 10–16, lanceolate, 4–8 by 2.5–4 cm, obtuse-emarginate to acuminate at the tip, cuneate or rounded and unequal at the base, glabrous; petiolule ca 3 mm. Flowers unknown. Pods ca 5 mm stipitate, 12–15 by 4 cm. Seeds 6–8, 14 x 7 mm; funicle 6 mm long.

description: Tree upto 40 m high; old specimens with buttresses up to 2 m high and 2 m wide; bark grayish; branches ± glabrous. Leaves with 2 pairs of leaflets (rarely 3). Petioles 1.5–4 cm long; rhachis 2–5 cm long; petiolules 2–8 mm. Leaflets normally asymmetric, ovate-obovate with rounded base; apex rounded, often slightly emarginate, 5–18 by 4–10 cm, glabrous, except for a stripe of hairs on: the midrib on the lower side. Inflorescence glabrous to greyish pubescent, 5–8 cm long, branched or unbranched; peduncle 1 cm. Receptacle glabrous to greyish pubescent of the same length as sepals. Sepals greenish, glabrous to hairy on outer side, 8–10 mm long. Petals white to pink (later red); claw 5 mm long; lamina 7–10 by 10–15 mm. Fertile stamens 3 cm long; anthers 2 mm long; staminodes 4–7, up to 10 mm long. Ovary shortly stipitate, pubescent; style pubescent at base, 4 cm long. Pods 8.5–25 by 4–5 cm, varying in shape. Seeds up to 8, ± orbicular; flat, 20–35mm diam.

description: Deciduous tree up to 50 m tall; buttresses up to 7 m high, 6 m wide; bark varying in colour. Petioles 1.5–2 cm; rhachis 10–15 cm. Leaves with 4 pairs of leaflets. Leaflets glabrous, ± asymmetric, glossy, on a 2–5 mm long petiolule; lamina up to 9 by 5 cm (even larger oh sterile shoots), smaller below the inflorescences, ± ovate lanceolate, rounded at base, narrowed towards apex; apex ± emarginate. Inflorescence greyish-green, 5–10 cm long. <i?>Peduncles 3–9 mm. Receptacle shorter than the sepals. Sepals 4–8 by 3–4 mm, outside puberulent, greyish. Petal white-yellowish, 6–9 mm long, distinctly clawed; lamina 3–4 mm broad. Fertile stamens 2 cm long. Ovary hirsute, shortly stipitate, yellowish green; style 2 cm long. Pods 15–40 by 6–8 cm. Seeds orbicular, 3 cm diam.

description: Tree up to 80 m high; buttresses high; bark smooth; young shoots pubescent. Stipules small, 2–4 mm, early caducous. Leaves: rachis ± pubescent, 6–8 cm. Petiole 1.5 cm; petiolules pubescent, 1–3 mm. Leaflets 7–12 rarely more, nearly equal in size, elliptic, symmetrical, 3–4 by 1–2 cm; upper surface glabrous, lower surface when young silky hairy, later finely, but densely appressed pubescent. Inflorescence an open panicle with pubescent branches. Bracts 1 mm; bracteoles smaller. Pedicel 1 mm. Flowers fragrant. Sepals 5, hairy outside, 3 mm long. Petals 5, white, glabrous, narrowly oblong, acute; when young shorter than sepals, later slightly longer. Stamens 5, free, longer than petals; filaments glabrous, stout; anthers oblong, 2–3 mm long. Ovary sessile, glabrous, oblong with few basal hairs. Mature pods 7–8 by 2–3 cm including the wing. Seed flat, oblong, 2–3 by 1 cm.

description: Tree up to 60 m high; buttresses high; bark irregular with narrow fissures and ridges; young shoots pubescent. Stipules broader than long, 2 mm broad. Leaves: rachis tawny pubescent, later nearly glabrous, 7–19 cm. Petiole 2–4 cm; petiolules pubescent, 4–7(–9) mm. Leaflets 5–9 rarely more, ovate-elliptic to oblong–elliptic, base rotundate, ± unequal sided, apex acuminate, 5–13 by 2–4 cm; upper surface ± glossy-glabrous, lower surface appressed pubescent. Inflorescences axillary, rarely terminal, dense panicles with puberulous branches. Bracts early caducous, 1 mm long; bracteoles smaller, not opposite. Pedicel 1–2.5 mm long. Flowers weakly fragrant. Sepals 5, hairy outside. Petals 5, white, greenish at base, with crispate, rounded apex, 2.5 mm long. Stamens 5, free, half as long as the petals; filaments slender widening at base; anthers heart-shaped. Ovary sessile, ferrugineous pubescent, compressed globose. Mature pods 12–13 by 3–4 cm. Seed flat, irregular oblong, up to 3 by 1 cm.

description: Shrub or small tree, 3–4 m high; young. shoots glabrous, armed with stiff prickles up to 2–3 cm, sometimes reddish. Leaves bipinnate with a short common petiole. ending with a spine and 2–4 pinnae; raehis broad, flattened arid ridged, “phylloclade like”, with numerous, very small, obovate leaflets, subopposite to alternate, 2–5 by 1 mm. Stipules 2, forming short spines. Flowers in axillary, glabrous racemes up to 20 cm. Bracts minute, caducous. Pedicels filiform, up to 15 mm. Buds ovoid, glabbrous. Receptacle flattened, very short. Sepals ovate-oblong, glabrous, reflexed, 5–7 mm long. Petals golden yellow with hairy claw, 12–14 mm long; the median one with 6 mm long claw and suborbicular lamina, the lateral ones with shorter claw and rhomboidal lamina. Stamens nearly equal, filaments hairy below the middle, widened towards base; anthers elliptic, 1.5 mm long, opening lengthwise. Ovary hairy, subsessile; style glabrous; stigma indistinct; ovules 6–15. Pods narrow, cylindric 5–15 by 0.5–0.7 cm, glabrous, yellowish, with 6 or more seeds. Seeds oblong, 10 by 4 mm.

description: Deciduous tree up to 25 m high; young shoots ferrugineous pubescent, later glabrous. Leaves 25–30 cm long. Stipules small, 1–2 mm. Pinnae 4–13 pairs. Leaflets 10–22 pairs, oblong-ovate, sessile, rounded to emarginate at apex, unequally attenuate towards base, nearly glabrous on upper surface, finely pubescent on lower, 12–18 by 5–7 mm. Panicle terminal, pyramidal, 20–40 cm long, densely ferruginous pubescent. Bracts caducous, 5–8 mm, obtuse. Pedicels 5–7 mm. Buds spherical, glabrous. Sepals ferrugineous pubescent on outer side, 5–8 by 5–6 mm. Petals yellow, obovate, 2 by 1 cm, densely hairy towards the short claw. Filaments 12–15 mm; anthers 3 mm long. Ovary stiped, hairy; ovules 3–4. Pods oblong with acute apex, tapering towards base, glabrous and longitudinally veined when ripe; up to 12 by 2.5 cm; wing-like margin 4–5 mm. Seeds 1–4, longitudinally arranged, flat, oblong, 10–12 by 5 mm.

description: Tree up to 20 m high; shoots finely tomentose, with pronounced pedicels. Stipules caduceus, falciform, with acute tip, glabrous, with ciliate margins, 10–15 by 5 mm. Petioles 15–25 mm long; rhachis puberulous, 8–10 cm. Leaflets 6–10, increasing in size towards apex, unequal-sided, lanceolate to ovate, glabrous on both sides when mature, up to 6 by 2.5 cm. Racemes fasciculate, 3–5 together on older branches, 3–5 flowered; main axis glabrous, 5–15 mm long. Bracts triangular, acute, caduceus, 1 mm long; bracteoles ± opposite, equal to thc bracts. Pedicels 1 cm. Sepals 4, imbricate red, boat-shaped, subcqual, 6–8 mm long. Petals 3, salmon-pink, fleshy, subequal, boat-shaped, with rounded apex and short claw, 6–10 by 4–5 mm; 2 rudimentary petals 1–2 mm long. Stamens connate at base to an open sheath, 2–10 mm long; filaments glabrous, red, varying in length, from 15–20 mm long; anthers 1 mm long, opening lengthwise. Ovary green, flattened, glabrous, 5 mm long, with a 1 mm long, red stipe; style red, glabrous, 15 mm long; stigma capitate; ovules few. Pods oblong (not seen in Thailand).

description: Climber or climbing shrub. Leaves: rhachis 12–18 cm; pinnae 6–8 pairs; leaf lets 8–10 pairs per pinna, oblong or obovate, 10–18 by 4–8 mm, entire. Panicles axillary and terminal, loosely flowering. Pedicels 3–4 mm, glabrous or subglabrous. Sepals glabrous. Petals subequal. Filaments glabrous. Ovary pubescent, 1–2-ovulate. Pods not stalked, seed-bearing part 13 by 8 mm; dorsal margin of the pod-wing 20–30 mm, the ventral one beginning towards the upper ⅓ of the seed-bearing part; the wing narrowed towards the base and enlarged towards the middle or the top.

description: Climber. Leaves: rhachis 15–20 cm; pinnae 7–-8 pairs; leaflets 7–10 pairs per pinna, elliptic-oblong, 8–12 by 5–7 mm, entire. Panicles terminal and axillary, loosely flowering. Pedicels 10–15 mm, glabrous. Sepals glabrous. Petals different in shape, the standard constricted towards the middle and hairy inside at the base. Filaments hairy. Ovary pubescent, 1-ovulate. Pods stalked above the receptacle (2–3 mm); seed-bearing part 20 by 12 mm; dorsal margin of the pod-wing 35–40 mm long, the ventral one beginning towards the middle or the upper ⅓ of the seed-bearing part; the wing narrowed towards the base and enlarged towards the middle.

description: Climber. Leaves: rhachis 10–15 cm; pinnae 4–6 pairs; leaflets 4 pairs per pinna, elliptic-ovate, 10–15 by 8–10 mm, denticulate. Panicles terminal and axillary, loosely flowering. Pedicels 3–5 mm, glabrous or subglabrous. Sepals subglabrous. Petals different in size and shape, the standard slightly larger, constricted towards the middle. Filaments hairy. Ovary glabous or pubescent on the upper margin, 1–2-ovulate. Pods not stalked; seed-bearing part 15 by 10 mm; dorsal margin of the pod-wing, 20–25 mm, the ventral one beginning towards the middle of the seed-bearing part; the wing not narrowed towards the base and not enlarged towards the middle.

description: Climber or climbing shrub. Leaves: rhachis 12–25 cm; pinnae 7–17 pairs; leaf-lets 12–25 pairs per pinna, linear-oblong, 6–12 by 1.5–4 mm, entire. Racemes axillary, combined into terminal densely flowering panicles. Pedicels 3–6 mm, pubescent. Sepals pubescent or glabrous. Petals different in size and shape, the standard larger, constricted towards the middle. Filaments densely hairy. Ovary pubescent all over or only on the upper margin, 2-ovulate. Pods not evidently stalked above the receptacle; seed-bearing part 12–20 by 10–15 mm; dorsal margin of the pod-wing 35–45 mm long, the ventral one beginning towards the base of the seed-bearing part; the wing narrowed towards the base and enlarged towards the middle.

description: Tree up to 20 m. Leaves: rhachis 10–50 cm long, glabrous; leaflets 1–7 pairs, elliptic-ovate to lanceolate, 5–30 by 1.5–10 cm, acute to obtuse at the tip, rounded, cordate or cuneate at the base, glabrous, brownish when dry; nerves 15, –20 pairs; petiolules 3–5 mm. Corymbs 3–15 cm diam; branches slender, up to 3 mm diam, glabrous. Bracts ovate to oval, 2–8 by 1.5–4.5 mm, fugacious or ± persistent; bracteoles ovate to oval-oblong, 3–8 by 1.5–4 mm, spreading, persistent or fugacious, orange-coloured. Pedicels 10–25 mm long, included the part above the bracteoles 5–10 mm long. Receptacle 7–16 mm long. Sepals 4, ovate-oblong, 5–12 by 2–7 mm, obtuse or rounded at the tip, orange-reddish. Stamens 6–8. Ovary pubescent along the margins; ovules 6–8. Pods ca 5 mm stipitate, oval to oblong-lanceolate, 6–25 by 2–6 cm, beaked at apex, cuneate or rounded at base.

description: Tree up to ca 10 m. Leaves: rhachis 20–75 cm long, glabrous; leaflets oval to oblong–Ianceolate, 7–32 by 3–9 cm, acute to acuminate at the tip, cuneate to rounded at the base, glabrous, dark brown when dry; nerves ca 12 pairs, curved along the margin; petiolules 10–15 mm. Corymbs robust; 15–35 cm diam; branches thick, 3–10 mm, glabrous. Bracts ovate, 12–35 by 7–22 mm, fugacious; bracteoles oblong-lanceolate, 6–17 by 2–5 mm, fugacious. Pedicels ca 10 mm, included the part above the bracteoles 2–5 mm long. Receptacle 12–26 mm long. Sepals 4, oval, 5–10 by 3.5–5 mm, yellow. Stamens (3–)4(–6). Ovary stipitate, hairy. Pods 10–20 mm stipitate, oblong-lanceolate, 15-40 by 3.5–8 cm, curved at apex and base, up to 15 mm long beaked.

description: Deciduous tree up to 40(–50) m high; young branches puberulous. Leaves 3–4-jugate. Petioles 3 cm long. Leaflets coriaceous, oblong to obovate, often slightly falcate, 5–10 by 3–5 cm; base unequal-sided, apex acute; shining on both surfaces, glabrous except for the midrib on the lower surface. Inflorescence densely brownish pubescent, 20–30 cm long. Bracts early caducous; bracteoles lanceolate, acute, 2 mm long. Pedicels puberulous, 1.5–2 mm. Receptacle 1.5–3 mm long. Sepals unarmed, strigose inside, 6–7 mm long. Petal yellow to red, narrowly lanceolate, 6–7 mm long. Stamens 2 largest, with filaments ca 1 cm long, anthers 2–3 mm long. Ovary shortly stipitate, hirsute; style recurved, glabrous; stigma inconspicuous; ovules 4–5. Pods glabrous, unarmed or with scattered blunt spines, broadly oblong, beaked, 7–8 by 5–6 cm. Seeds 2–3.

description: Tree up to 40 m high; young branches fine brownish pubescent. Leave 3–4 jugate. Petioles 2–3 cm. Leaflets coriaceous, elliptic to oblong-elliptic, 4–7 ty 2–2.5 cm, apex and base rounded; both sides finely reticulate, upper side glabrous, lower finely puberulous. Inflorescence 10–15 cm long. Bracts orbicular, 5–7 mm, puberulous, persistent during anthesis; bracteoles slightly smaller; lanceolate. Pedicels puberulous, 3 mm. Sepals with spinescent outgrowths nearly to the base, strigose inside, 6–7 mm long. Petal orange, narrowly lanceolate, 7–8 mm long. Stamens 2 largest, with filaments 1–1.5 cm long, anthers 3 mm long; filament-sheath short, hirsute. Ovary shortly stipitate, densely hirsute with spiny outgrowths; style recurved; stigma inconspicuous; ovules few. Pods dehiscent, puberulous when young, later glabrescent, spiny, broadly elliptic; beaked, 6.5 by 4.5 cm. Seeds 2–3.

description: Tree up to 20 m high, rarely more; young twigs pubescent later glabrous. Leaves parlpinnate, with 10–18 pairs of small leaflets. Petioles and rhachis 5–12cm long, pubescent to glabrous. Stipules minute, caducous. Petiolules glabrous or pubescent. Leaflets glabrous, oblong-linear, unequal, at base rounded, at apex mucronatc, 8–30 by 3–9 mm. Racemes terminal, 2–6 cm with a ± puberulous axis. Bracts ovate-oblong caducous, 5 by 3 mm. Pedicels puberulous to glabrescent, up to 10 mm; bracteoles similar to the bracts, densely ciliate, pubescent on lower surface, glabrous on upper. Receptacle narrowly turbinate, 4–4.5 mm long. Sepals 4, oblong-elliptic, imbricate, yellowish, glabrous but hairy at base, 12 by 5 mm. Petals 3, unequal, yellowish-orange; upper petal oblong-cordate, 10–12 by 2–3 mm; 2 lateral ones, obovate-oblong, narrowed towards the hairy base, 12–13 mm long, 5–6 mm broad. Perfect stamens 3, connate to an open staminal tube, filaments short; tube plus filaments 12–15 mm long; anthers oblong. Ovary ± pubescent, linear. 7 mm long on an equally long stipe; style rather thick, 7 mm long, pubescent; stigma terminal, truncate, subcapitate. Pods oblong, incurved, thick, light brown, indehiscent, 5–15 by 1–2.5 cm; mesocarp pulpy, acid. Seeds compressed, obovate-orbicular, varying in shape, ca 1 cm long, glossy, dark brown.
